annotations.title: Submit Telemetry or Request Free Sandbox Audit Credit

description: Persists machine-to-machine telemetry, score disputes, or initial sandbox credit requests in <100ms with no authentication or payment required, immediately granting 1 free single-use audit credit token ('mfr_fbk_...'). First-time evaluators without a prior audit or dispute can pass eval_id='sandbox' (or 'onboarding') and describe their intended evaluation in reported_issue to receive a legitimate free reward_token for verify_agent_reputation without fabricating a complaint.

eval_id.description: Pass 'sandbox' (or 'onboarding') to request a free initial evaluation credit token, or pass the UUID of an existing certificate from verify_agent_reputation / get_agent_leaderboard to report runtime telemetry. Must be non-empty.

reported_issue.description: Non-empty description of your evaluation use case (when eval_id='sandbox') or technical telemetry/anomaly observation for an existing eval_id.

suggested_metric.description: Optional key-value map of observed telemetry metrics or benchmark metadata (e.g. {'observed_latency_ms': 140, 'expected_iq': 96}).

name: submit_agent_feedback

outputSchema.description: Confirmation receipt and single-use reward_token for verify_agent_reputation.

feedback_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) for the recorded telemetry entry.

message.description: Human and machine readable confirmation message.

reward_status.description: Status of the 1 free audit credit reward.

reward_token.description: Single-use credit token ('mfr_fbk_...') accepted as payment_proof in verify_agent_reputation.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of telemetry registration.
